raw_meta_yaml:
{% set version = "2.5.0" %}
{% set commit = "934920a46781142c2b8f0177007c395eae601783" %}  # https://github.com/astra-toolbox/astra-toolbox/releases/tag/v2.5.0
{% set build = 1 %}

package:
  name: astra-toolbox-split
  version: {{ version }}

source:
  url: https://github.com/astra-toolbox/astra-toolbox/archive/{{ commit }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 41ceab45a118df92e1d9c7ffaf17a1eb4441d8450f35ddc5b75d8545a6af4d98
  patches:
  # patch created from askorikov/astra-toolbox@release_2.5.0_cmake
    - cmake.patch

build:
  number: {{ build }}

outputs:
  - name: libastra
    script: build_libastra.bat  # [win]
    script: build_libastra.sh   # [unix]
    build:
      number: {{ build }}
      string: "cuda{{ cuda_compiler_version|string }}h{{ PKG_HASH }}_{{ build + 100 }}"  # [cuda_compiler_version != "None"]
      track_features:
        # Mark CPU-only version as an extra feature to deprioritize it in favor of
        # CUDA-enabled version when both are available.
        - nocuda_la6JwwDGF7  # [cuda_compiler_version == "None"]
      run_exports:
        - {{ pin_subpackage('libastra', max_pin='x.x.x') }}
        - libastra =*=cuda*  # [cuda_compiler_version != "None"]
        - libastra =*=h*     # [cuda_compiler_version == "None"]
      script_env:
        - ASTRA_USE_CUDA=ON   # [cuda_compiler_version != "None"]
        - ASTRA_USE_CUDA=OFF  # [cuda_compiler_version == "None"]
        - CUDAARCHS=all       # [cuda_compiler_version != "None"]
        - CMAKE_GENERATOR=Ninja
    requirements:
      build:
        - {{ compiler('cuda') }}  # [cuda_compiler_version != "None"]
        - {{ compiler('cxx') }}
        - {{ stdlib("c") }}
        - cmake >=3.23
        - ninja
      host:
        - cuda-version {{ cuda_compiler_version }}  # [cuda_compiler_version != "None"]
        - cuda-cudart-dev  # [cuda_compiler_version != "None"]
        - libcufft-dev     # [cuda_compiler_version != "None"]
      run:
        # cuda-version only includes __cuda in run_constrained, but we want it to be stronger
        - __cuda  # [cuda_compiler_version != "None"]
    test:
      commands:
        - test -f $PREFIX/lib/libastra${SHLIB_EXT}                          # [linux]
        - test -f $PREFIX/lib/libastra${SHLIB_EXT}.0                        # [linux]
        - test -f $PREFIX/lib/libastra${SHLIB_EXT}.0.0.0                    # [linux]
        # Library named differently from upstream because it makes linking
        # consistent between platforms. File links don't work on Windows.
        - if not exist %LIBRARY_LIB%\\astra.lib exit 1  # [win]
        - if not exist %LIBRARY_BIN%\\astra.dll exit 1  # [win]
    about:
      summary: >
        libastra is a C++ library of high-performance GPU primitives for 2D and 3D tomography.

  - name: astra-toolbox
    script: build_python_interface.bat  # [win]
    script: build_python_interface.sh   # [unix]
    build:
      number: {{ build }}
      string: "cudapy{{ py }}h{{ PKG_HASH }}_{{ build + 100 }}"  # [cuda_compiler_version != "None"]
      script_env:
        - ASTRA_USE_CUDA=ON   # [cuda_compiler_version != "None"]
        - ASTRA_USE_CUDA=OFF  # [cuda_compiler_version == "None"]
      # Only build Python bindings on one CUDA version (it's compatible with all CUDA versions)
      skip: true  # [cuda_compiler_version == "12.9"]
      # Astra doesn't support freethreading on Windows at the moment
      skip: true  # [is_freethreading and win]
    requirements:
      build:
        - python                                 # [build_platform != target_platform]
        - cross-python_{{ target_platform }}     # [build_platform != target_platform]
        - cython >=3.1                           # [build_platform != target_platform]
        - numpy                                  # [build_platform != target_platform]
        - {{ compiler('cxx') }}
        - {{ stdlib('c') }}
      host:
        - libastra =={{ version }}
        - libastra * cuda*  # [cuda_compiler_version != "None"]
        - libastra * h*     # [cuda_compiler_version == "None"]
        - cython >=3.1
        - numpy
        - pip
        - python
        - setuptools
      run:
        # Need another pin here because run_exports doesn't work in-between subpackages
        - libastra =={{ version }}
        - libastra * cuda*  # [cuda_compiler_version != "None"]
        - libastra * h*     # [cuda_compiler_version == "None"]
        - python
        - scipy
    test:
      imports:
        - astra
      commands:
        - python -c "import astra; astra.test()"

about:
  home: http://www.astra-toolbox.com
  license: GPL-3.0-only
  license_file:
    - COPYING
    - lib/licenses/rapidxml.txt
    - lib/licenses/dlpack.txt
  summary: >
    The ASTRA Toolbox is a Python toolbox of high-performance GPU primitives for 2D and 3D tomography.

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - askorikov
    - carterbox
